planSteps.description: Verify that `onFileSend` handler is registered in `index.js` — check if CommunicationAgent's FILE_SEND intent is wired to a handler function
Confirm FileAgent receives `searchDirs` context in `index.js` — ensure it can locate files in the project
Verify WhatsAppProvider has a `sendFile()` method — check that it can send document attachments via WhatsApp API
Test end-to-end: Send "send me the PRD file" message via WhatsApp to the bot
Verify the PRD file arrives as a document attachment in WhatsApp chat
If file doesn't arrive, add logging to CommunicationAgent.onFileSend to trace the intent handling
If logging shows the handler is called but file doesn't send, debug FileAgent.findFile() to confirm it locates the PRD
If file is found but not sent, debug WhatsAppProvider.sendFile() to confirm it successfully uploads to WhatsApp
